project.name: grounded-docparse
project.description: A workstation-oriented document parser that creates grounded Markdown and structured JSON from local OCR evidence, with bounded optional agent workflows.

nodes.name: Document Evidence Processing
nodes.summary: Handles conversion of uploaded documents into normalized page evidence, OCR-derived structure, and grounded deliverables. Its rules preserve source geometry, confidence, and reviewable evidence through parsing and recovery.

businessRules: Evidence structure remains grounded through rendering and recovery.
crossDomainInteractions: Supplies parsed evidence to agentic extraction and user review workflows.

nodes.name: Grounded Document Intelligence
nodes.summary: Provides schema-guided extraction, form routing, classification, table-of-contents generation, and document chat over completed parsed documents. It validates evidence references so optional model-assisted features remain bounded by source material.

businessRules: Structured field values require grounded evidence.
Routing and extraction operate on prepared document context.
crossDomainInteractions: Consumes document evidence and returns reviewed results to workspace and interface flows.

nodes.name: Workstation Document Workflows
nodes.summary: Exposes interactive and command-line routes for submitting documents, reviewing routing decisions, retaining workspace state, and exporting results. It turns parser and extraction capabilities into repeatable user workflows.

businessRules: User review is applied before routed document processing.
Workspace persistence retains documents and parser artifacts for later retrieval.
crossDomainInteractions: Invokes document processing and exposes grounded extraction outcomes to operators.

nodes.name: Runtime and Quality Assurance
nodes.summary: Provisioning, OCR-service control, evaluation, and regression reporting keep local execution and quality measurement operational. It separates runtime setup from document workflows while enforcing policy around evaluation artifacts.

businessRules: Only one managed local OCR stack is active.
Evaluation writes reports and regression artifacts from parsed outputs.
crossDomainInteractions: Provides local OCR capabilities to document processing and assesses its grounded results.

nodes.name: Ingest and Render Document
nodes.summary: Validates an upload, produces normalized page evidence, analyzes document structure, and renders grounded outputs.

nodes.name: Recover Document Evidence
nodes.summary: Selects the configured local OCR service, normalizes its output, evaluates evidence quality, and applies bounded repair before annotation.

nodes.name: Extract Grounded Fields
nodes.summary: Validates an extraction schema, prepares bounded context, resolves evidence, and constructs citation-backed structured fields.

nodes.name: Route Document Forms
nodes.summary: Uses classification profiles and reviewed segment decisions to determine which form content is eligible for downstream extraction.

nodes.name: Review and Export in Studio
nodes.summary: Guides users through upload, parser configuration, routing review, workspace persistence, and export in the Streamlit studio.

nodes.name: Run Repeatable CLI Batch
nodes.summary: Discovers command-line inputs, selects parser options, processes documents in batches, and writes result artifacts.

nodes.name: Provision and Run Local OCR
nodes.summary: Installs the supported WSL runtime, prepares a selected OCR backend, maintains one managed stack, and launches the workstation application.

nodes.name: Evaluate Regression Corpus
nodes.summary: Runs corpus parsing, aggregates grounded-output metrics and telemetry, and writes regression reports under policy enforcement.

nodes.name: Validate Upload
nodes.summary: Checks upload size, filename type, and supported PDF or image contents before ingestion.

nodes.name: Create Page Evidence
nodes.summary: Persists the upload and dispatches PDF or image ingestion to create normalized page evidence.

nodes.name: Analyze Page Structure
nodes.summary: Analyzes layout, OCR, reading order, and visual features to create grounded page drafts.

nodes.name: Assemble Parse Result
nodes.summary: Combines OCR, quality, recovery, rendering, and result assembly in the end-to-end parser.

nodes.name: Render Grounded Outputs
nodes.summary: Renders parsed structures as Markdown, elements, combined results, and annotated PDF output.

nodes.name: Select Managed OCR Engine
nodes.summary: Selects and initializes the managed local OCR engine from parser configuration.

nodes.name: Normalize OCR Regions
nodes.summary: Converts local OCR responses into normalized regions with geometry, confidence, and recognition status.

nodes.name: Evaluate Evidence Quality
nodes.summary: Evaluates page quality and selects evidence-based recovery or repair candidates.

nodes.name: Apply Bounded Repair
nodes.summary: Applies parser recovery planning and repair decisions while retaining the document evidence model.

nodes.name: Annotate Source Evidence
nodes.summary: Produces annotated PDF output for grounded visual evidence when that output is applicable.

nodes.name: Validate Extraction Schema
nodes.summary: Validates the schema used to constrain grounded field extraction.

nodes.name: Prepare Agentic Context
nodes.summary: Builds bounded document segments, page Markdown, and element indexes for downstream operations.

nodes.name: Resolve Evidence Citations
nodes.summary: Validates extracted content and resolves it against document evidence.

nodes.name: Construct Structured Result
nodes.summary: Builds citation-backed structured fields from parsed documents.

nodes.name: Load Classifier Profile
nodes.summary: Loads persisted classifier-profile definitions used to guide document routing.

nodes.name: Prepare Document Segments
nodes.summary: Prepares segment payloads and active elements for routing and extraction operations.

nodes.name: Validate Routing Decisions
nodes.summary: Validates segmentation and effective segment decisions before downstream extraction.

nodes.name: Extract Eligible Forms
nodes.summary: Coordinates classification, extraction, and grounded result production for eligible document segments.

nodes.name: Collect Upload and Settings
nodes.summary: Manages uploads, parser settings, and document state in the Streamlit studio.

nodes.name: Apply Routing Review
nodes.summary: Applies user-reviewed page-routing decisions before document processing.

nodes.name: Persist Workspace State
nodes.summary: Persists workspace documents, batches, and parser artifacts for later retrieval.

nodes.name: Present Results and Exports
nodes.summary: Presents parsed and extraction results for review and export in the workstation interface.

nodes.name: Parse Command Options
nodes.summary: Parses CLI options for discovering inputs and selecting parser behavior.

nodes.name: Discover and Process Inputs
nodes.summary: Coordinates batch document processing and aggregates individual document results.

nodes.name: Write Result Artifacts
nodes.summary: Writes rendered parser outputs and batch artifacts for repeatable command-line use.

nodes.name: Provision WSL Runtime
nodes.summary: Creates and configures the WSL environment for the local GLM-OCR runtime.

nodes.name: Prepare Selected OCR Backend
nodes.summary: Prepares GLM-OCR or PaddleOCR local runtime dependencies for execution.

nodes.name: Manage Single OCR Stack
nodes.summary: Ensures exactly one managed local OCR service stack runs in WSL.

nodes.name: Launch Studio
nodes.summary: Starts the selected OCR engine and Streamlit application with health checks and process locking.

nodes.name: Parse Evaluation Options
nodes.summary: Parses command-line options for live corpus evaluation and policy enforcement.

nodes.name: Run Corpus Parses
nodes.summary: Runs corpus parsing and evaluation across document cases.

nodes.name: Aggregate Quality Metrics
nodes.summary: Defines benchmark cases, evaluation metrics, and report generation for document parsing quality.

nodes.name: Write Regression Report
nodes.summary: Writes regression artifacts and reports from evaluated grounded outputs.

edges.description: Parsed source evidence and grounded outputs supply the context used by extraction and routing.
Routing, extraction, and reviewable results are exposed through studio and CLI workflows.
Managed OCR services and regression evaluation support evidence processing quality.
Studio and CLI workflows depend on provisioned local OCR services and benefit from regression reporting.
